scope.icons: Every registered T3Icons identifier from typo3/sysext/core/Resources/Public/Icons/T3Icons/icons.json, plus its registered aliases. Complete for that file.
scope.labels: The English trans-units of 118 of the 254 default XLF files in the core, across 29 of the system extensions. A curated subset, not the whole core.
scope.components: Hand-curated backend UI components from the styleguide and the backend Sass sources. A subset: not every CSS class in the core is described here.
